snippet.title: Tidy Up: Bricks n Blocks | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Someone tipped the whole toy box out. Pick up every brick, find the shelf that matches its shape, and drop it in the bin that matches its color.

Tidy Up: Bricks n Blocks is a cozy tidying game for Windows, Mac, and Linux. Work through 14 toy shop rooms in the Campaign, or tip all 114 shapes out at once in Cozy Mode. Bring up to three friends along in online co-op.
